why._comment: Why it moved (src/why.js): Claude reads each top mover's driving posts and writes the reason beside the momentum number. top = movers by |momentum - 50| among macro topics and story subtopics; every story (story: true subtopic, or emerging story candidate) with >= min_story_posts_24h posts in the last 24h is added. Per mover: max_posts driving posts from the last 24h plus baseline_posts from the prior six days; a mover with fewer than min_posts readable posts is skipped. One call per mover, cached in data/why.json by the hash of the post ids read; daily_calls caps spend per ET day. Model falls back to classify.model.

anthropic._comment: Workload identity federation ids for GitHub Actions (public identifiers, not secrets). The rule only accepts OIDC tokens from this repo's main branch. Outside Actions, set CLASSIFIER_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) instead.

narrative_lists._comment: Public X Lists the narrative layer may scan (owner: the credential account). role: who is on it; priority 1 = scan first (Democratic side and the press that covers it), 3 = counter-message only. Reads are billed per post returned and go through the daily ledger.
